messages.text: 🌱 Ramesh Patil created the pool. Invite fellow farmers using the invite link, then agree on a price here.
👋 Sita Devi joined with 25 quintals. Pool total: 65 quintals.
✅ All 2 farmer(s) agreed on ₹2,450 per quintal. The coordinator can now send the pool's offer to buyers.
📧 Offer of ₹2,450/quintal for 65 quintals was emailed to Sharma Mills. Replies will appear here.

emails.name: Sharma Mills
emails.subject: [KS-4B7LG6] 65 quintals of Wheat available at ₹2,450/quintal – KrishiSetu Farmer Pool
emails.body:
Dear Sharma Mills team,

I am writing on behalf of "Sehore Wheat Pool", a pool of 2 verified farmer(s) registered on KrishiSetu, who have agreed on a single collective price for their harvest.

OFFER SUMMARY
  Crop:               Wheat
  Total quantity:     65 quintals
  Agreed price:       Rs. 2,450 per quintal (all farmers unanimously agreed)
  Expected harvest:   2026-10-31
  Growing region:     Sehore, Madhya Pradesh

PARTICIPATING FARMERS
  - Ramesh Patil (Sehore, Madhya Pradesh): 40 quintals
  - Sita Devi (Ashta, Madhya Pradesh): 25 quintals

MESSAGE FROM THE POOL COORDINATOR
Pickup from farm

Please reply to this email with your offer, any counter-price, quality requirements, payment terms and pickup details. Simply hit Reply.
Your reply will be delivered to every farmer in the pool.

Pool coordinator: Ramesh Patil, 9854821142
Pool reference: KS-4B7LG6

Regards,
Sehore Wheat Pool · via KrishiSetu
